turns.question: Which campaign had the highest total ad spend between 17 August and 2 October 2026, and how much did it spend in EUR?
turns.answer: Search NL always-on had the highest ad spend, 5,795.00 EUR, from 17 August to 2 October 2026 (inclusive). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
